integrity: Proof and bounded independent boundary-matrix cross-checks are self-contained in embedded files; all integral assertions arise from the written homotopy argument.
scientific_limitations: Stagewise homotopy only; no complete persistent barcode, inclusion-induced map, or equivariant classification. Real-parameter theorem proved by joins and threshold graphs; finite mod-two checks corroborate rather than certify the theorem. Prior-literature coverage may be incomplete.
title: All-scale homotopy of axis-deformed cross-polytope Vietoris–Rips complexes
